name: Soyuz-13
about: Soyuz-13 (1973-103A), a crewed vehicle (7K-TX), launched 1973 Dec 18. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1973 Dec 20), held fixed
